subject: Air freight quote to GRU
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well. Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option to GRU (Sao Paulo, BR)? Please include pickup from our site in 61391 (Bad Homburg), Germany, and arrange the truck to the departure airport.

The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-25. It’s 3 pieces of industrial adhesives, with a gross weight of 715 kg and a total volume of 2.65 cbm. The goods are general cargo, non-dangerous, and I’ve attached our packing specification.

Thanks for taking a look!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
